final_decision.primary_cell_type: ONE primary label (free text, no mixed/doublet words)
final_decision.mixture_explanation: short text explaining mixed/doublet/contamination if present

audit_report.notes: Short, audit-style notes explaining why each reviewer is or is not supported by ORIGINAL evidence.

third_party_adjudication.primary_cell_type: string (required if ALL THREE reviewers are explicitly unsupported; otherwise can be null)
third_party_adjudication.why_reviewers_failed: Short explanation of why CASSIA/in-house/enrichment are unsupported (if applicable).

supporting: string (must mention concrete genes/pmids/terms when available)

actions.action_type: subcluster | qc_recheck | deg_rerun | doublet_check | ambient_check | reference_mapping | ontology_fix | visual_check | other
actions.why: Trigger rationale grounded in ORIGINAL evidence (cite genes/pmids/terms).
actions.how: Executable steps (e.g., rerun DE with covariate; re-cluster at higher resolution; run doublet detection).
actions.expected_outcomes: If outcome A then ..., if outcome B then ...
